items.title: terminal: Focus restored zoomed terminal panels

labels.name: area:integrations/terminal
labels.description: Feedback for terminal integration, shell commands, etc

labels.name: cla-signed
labels.description: The user has signed the Contributor License Agreement

items.body:
# Objective

Fixes #61417.

When a terminal panel was restored full-screen after delayed shell initialization, the panel became visible and zoomed but focus remained in the editor behind it.

## Solution

When restoring a visible, zoomed dock after its active panel is registered, focus that panel as part of restoring the dock state.

Do not move focus when the restored dock is hidden or when a modal is active.

## Testing

- `cargo test -p terminal_view --lib`
- `cargo test -p workspace --lib`
- `ITERATIONS=20 cargo test -p terminal_view test_delayed_restored_zoomed_terminal -- --nocapture`
- `./script/clippy -p terminal_view -p workspace`
- `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- `cargo build -p zed`

Added regression coverage for delayed zoomed-terminal restoration, including the active-modal case.

Manually verified on macOS with an isolated user-data directory and a shell delayed by four seconds. After quitting with the terminal panel visible and zoomed, the workspace reopened with the terminal full-screen; `echo FOCUS_OK` executed in the terminal, and the editor fixture remained unchanged.

## AI assistance

Codex was used to implement and test this change. The resulting diff was critically reviewed, simplified, and checked by temporarily removing the production fix to confirm that the new regression test failed for the expected reason.

Release Notes:

- Fixed restored full-screen terminal panels leaving focus in an editor behind them

items.title: project: Reload stale Git commit messages when reopened

labels.name: cla-signed
labels.description: The user has signed the Contributor License Agreement

items.body:
# Objective

Fixes #61278.

When Zed is used as `$GIT_EDITOR`, reopening `COMMIT_EDITMSG` can reuse a cached buffer containing the previous commit message instead of loading the current file contents.

## Solution

- Reload cached `COMMIT_EDITMSG` buffers that are local, clean, present on disk, and located beneath a `.git` directory, including linked-worktree and submodule gitdirs.
- Share an in-progress cached-buffer reload so simultaneous opens perform one disk read.
- Compute reload diffs from the text and version captured before disk I/O. If the user edits while the read is in progress, preserve the edit and report a conflict instead of overwriting it.
- Keep dirty buffers untouched.

Single-file worktrees remain handled by their existing file watcher, avoiding a second competing reload for external gitdirs.

## Testing

- `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- `git diff --check`
- `./script/clippy -p fs -p language -p project`
- `cargo test -p fs --lib` — 15 passed
- `cargo test -p language --lib` — 147 passed
- `cargo test -p project --lib` — 44 passed, 1 ignored
- `cargo test -p project --test integration` — 306 passed, 3 ignored
- `ITERATIONS=100 cargo test -p language --lib test_reload_preserves_edit_made_while_loading -- --nocapture`
- `ITERATIONS=100 cargo test -p project --test integration git_editor_buffer -- --nocapture`

The integration coverage follows the issue's repeated-commit reproduction and also covers simultaneous opens, dirty buffers, and a linked-worktree gitdir. Tested on macOS. This change has no visual impact.

## Self-Review Checklist:

- [x] I've reviewed my own diff for quality, security, and reliability
- [x] Unsafe blocks (if any) have justifying comments
- [x] The content adheres to Zed's UI standards ([UX/UI](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#uiux-checklist) and [icon](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/blob/main/crates/icons/README.md) guidelines)
- [x] Tests cover the new/changed behavior
- [x] Performance impact has been considered and is acceptable

---

Release Notes:

- Fixed stale commit messages when using Zed as a Git editor

items.title: settings: Preserve tab indentation in Settings UI updates

labels.name: cla-signed
labels.description: The user has signed the Contributor License Agreement

items.body:
# Objective

Fixes #59949.

Settings UI edits infer indentation width from tree-sitter columns. A tab occupies one tree-sitter column, so newly inserted settings use one space even when `settings.json` uses hard tabs.

## Solution

Represent JSON indentation as either spaces or tabs and carry that style through object and array updates.

Infer the style from syntactic JSON properties and array items so comment alignment does not affect detection. Mixed files follow the nearest existing sibling for nested edits and the first syntactic item at document scope. Compact files fall back to explicit JSONC, JSON, or global indentation settings while empty files retain the canonical two-space format.

Existing numeric callers remain compatible and continue to request space indentation.

## Testing

- Added a SettingsStore GPUI regression covering Settings UI updates to tab-indented `settings.json` files.
- Added unit coverage for tab and space inference, mixed indentation, comment-heavy JSONC, nested objects, compact files, and arrays.
- `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- `cargo test -p settings_json -p settings`
- `./script/clippy -p settings_json -p settings`
- `cargo check -p keymap_editor -p dev_container`
- `git diff --check`

Tested on macOS. The changed formatter and SettingsStore paths are platform-independent.

## Self-Review Checklist:

- Fixed Settings UI changes replacing tab indentation in `settings.json` with spaces.

items.body:
# Objective

Fixes #60518.

Zed sends an empty `name` for entries in `initialize.params.workspaceFolders`. Language servers such as basedpyright use this field to identify workspace service instances, resulting in an unnamed instance.

## Solution

Derive each workspace folder name from its URI, preferring the decoded filesystem basename. For basename-less URIs, fall back to a non-empty path, URI path segment, or the full URI.

Use the same construction for initialization parameters, dynamic workspace-folder notifications, and `workspace/workspaceFolders` responses so all LSP messages remain consistent.

## Testing

- `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- `cargo test -p lsp`
- `cargo check -p project --all-targets --all-features`
- `./script/clippy -p lsp`
- `./script/clippy -p project`

Reproduced with basedpyright 1.39.9 over an LSP stdio session. Before this change it logged:

```text
Starting service instance ""
```

With a derived workspace folder name it logged:

```text
Starting service instance "zed-60518-project"
```

Tested on macOS.

items.body:
Closes #60733

# Objective

Markdown Preview treats a relative `path:line[:column]` destination as a literal filename. When that file does not exist, the link falls through to the system URL handler instead of opening the workspace file at the requested position.

## Solution

- Recognize position suffixes on relative Markdown links.
- Convert GitHub-style `#L42` fragments into the same positioned target used by `path:42`, so both forms share one resolution and opening path.
- Resolve links with `workspace::path_link::possible_open_target` using the Markdown source directory. This keeps the remote-project path resolution added in #61438.
- Open resolved targets with `editor::items::open_resolved_target`, including its one-based row and column handling.
- Preserve valid URI schemes and fall back to the existing Markdown link behavior when no workspace target resolves.

## Testing

- Extended the Markdown Preview GPUI regression test to cover relative `path:line:column`, GitHub-style `#Lline`, subfolder-relative resolution, and custom URI schemes.
- `git diff --check` passes.
- The focused Rust test could not start in the current macOS environment because the Rust toolchain binaries hang in the dynamic loader before Cargo runs. PR Actions are awaiting maintainer approval.

## Self-Review Checklist:

- [x] I have reviewed my own diff for quality, security, and reliability
- [x] Unsafe blocks (if any) have justifying comments
- [x] The content adheres to Zed UI and icon guidelines
- [x] Tests cover the new and changed behavior
- [x] Performance impact has been considered and is acceptable

Release Notes:

- Fixed Markdown Preview links using workspace-relative paths with line and column suffixes.
